title: Somich & Associates CPAs Opens Its New Willoughby Home
summary: New address, same handshake. Somich & Associates CPAs threw open the doors on Mentor Avenue for an afternoon-into-evening celebration of the clients and neighbors who built the firm.
recap: Willoughby, OH – November 12, 2026 – Tax season is still months away, but on Thursday the busiest room in Lake County belonged to a CPA firm. Somich & Associates CPAs marked the move into its new office at 38879 Mentor Avenue with a Client & Community Appreciation Open House, and the guest list read like a who's who of the people who keep Northeast Ohio's small businesses running.

From 2 p.m. until well past sunset, clients, colleagues and neighbors drifted through the fresh new space, trading the usual quarterly check-in for drinks, light bites and the kind of conversations that don't happen over email. Owner Andrew Somich and partner David Silverman worked the room like hosts, not accountants: welcoming longtime clients, introducing the team, and showing off a home built for the firm's next chapter.
The verdict? A firm that clearly values its relationships as much as its balance sheets. Here's to the new address, and to the people who made it possible.

title: Proof Public House: Matt Fish Turns It Up in Ohio City
summary: Pierogi, Parmageddon and a punk-rock soundtrack. We shot the menu at Matt Fish's Ohio City hangout, from starters to zero-proof cocktails.
recap: Cleveland, OH – Matt Fish built an empire on grilled cheese and loud guitars. With Proof Public House on Lorain Avenue, his first brand-new concept in nearly two decades, he's turned the volume back up, and we spent a session in the kitchen making sure the food looks as loud as the room.

The menu reads like a set list. Starters open hard with Beet Muhammara, Corn Dip, Pierogi and dueling Chicken and Tofu Wings. The middle of the set belongs to the sandwiches: the Proof Burger, the Spring Chicken, a Mapo Tofu Burger and the aptly named Parmageddon. A Chicken & Sausage Gumbo and a Vegan Shepherd's Pie prove the plant-based side of the menu isn't an afterthought, and the Peanut Butter Chocolate Cake is the encore.

The bar holds its own without the booze, too: zero-proof cocktails like Purple Rain, Dismantle Me and Parinoid are built for the camera as much as the glass. Add a kids' menu that doesn't phone it in, and a room covered in concert posters and Melt-era memorabilia, and you've got the most fun plate in Ohio City.
